info.description:
# Go Web API - Modular REST API

## Environment Setup

**Variables Required:**
- `base_url`: http://localhost:8080/api/v1
- `token`: (auto-set on login)
- `refresh_token`: (auto-set on login)
- `user_id`: (auto-set on login)
- `tenant_slug`: acme6

## Modules

- **Auth**: Authentication & session management  
- **Users**: User CRUD (admin only)  
- **Tenants**: Multi-tenant management  
- **Tracking**: GPS tracking for transport companies

## Valid Enum Values

**company_type**: `school` | `corporate` | `transport_provider`  
**vehicle_status**: `active` | `maintenance` | `inactive`  
**route_type**: `pickup` | `dropoff` | `round_trip`  
**event_type**: `pickup` | `dropoff` | `absence` | `delay`  
**alert_severity**: `low` | `medium` | `high` | `critical`  
**access_level**: `read_only` | `read_write`  

## Quick Start

1. Set `base_url` in environment
2. Run `Auth > Login` to get tokens
3. Tokens auto-save to environment
4. All protected endpoints auto-refresh on 401

request.description: Authenticate user with email/password. Returns JWT tokens that are automatically saved to environment.

Get list of tenants accessible to the current user
Update tenant information (owner/admin only)
Add a user to the tenant with specified role (owner/admin only)
Remove a user from the tenant (owner/admin only)
Run database migrations on tenant database (super_admin only)
Create a transport company. Valid company_type values: school | corporate | transport_provider
Grant a client tenant (school) access to track this transport company
Get real-time GPS location of vehicle
GPS device endpoint (no auth required, uses API key)
Get real-time route execution status
Get real-time rider status (pickup, in-transit, dropped-off)
Record events: pickup, dropoff, absence, delay
Create alerts: delay, emergency, breakdown, traffic
